name: Ischgl
kurzbeschreibung: World-famous ski resort in the **Paznauntal** valley, featuring summit concerts, the **Silvretta** ski area, and 240 kilometers of runs stretching into neighboring **Samnaun**.
beschreibung: Ischgl in the Paznauntal is one of the most famous ski destinations in the Alps. The ski resort Silvretta Arena Ischgl-Samnaun spans Austria and Switzerland, offering over 240 kilometers of well-groomed ski runs. Renowned for its annual Gipfelkonzerte featuring international top stars on the Ischgl stage at 2,300 meters above sea level, the area also shines in summer: hiking through the stunning Silvretta mountain landscape, mountain biking on the Paznaun Bike Network, and electric bike tours along the Trisanna River.
oeffnungszeiten: Skibetrieb: Nov–Mai; Sommer: Jun–Okt; Geschäfte & Restaurants ganzjährig
